title: Mistborn: Secret History
author: Brandon Sanderson
summary: A novella set in the ash-covered world of Mistborn, where metal-burning magic and a long-ruling tyrant shaped a rebellion. It revisits the events of the original trilogy from a new angle, and is meant for readers who have finished it.
readIf: you have finished the Mistborn trilogy and want a short, clever companion that reframes what you already know.
skipIf: you are new to Mistborn, as it spoils the original trilogy and makes little sense without it.

pairings.reason: The trilogy's last book, which you should finish before opening this novella.
A short, polished Sanderson novella with a self-contained magic system and a tidy story.
Another fantasy with crews, clever plans and loyal friends, set in a very different world.
